description: ¡Bienvenidos a Casa Rinconcito en el Cielo — tu pequeño rincón en el paraíso! Just 3 minutes by car (or a breezy 15-minute stroll) to the beach, Rinconcito has everything you need to unwind. Walk 2 minutes to Rincón’s plaza for the Thursday Art Walk or kick off your weekend at the Saturday farmer’s market. With private parking, a cozy backyard for dining, an outdoor shower, backup generator and more, your perfect getaway starts here. Come stay and make some memories at Casa Rinconcito!The spaceCasa Rinconcito is your charming home away from home, where tropical vibes meet modern comfort. This spacious retreat features three inviting bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and plenty of room for families and friends to unwind. Step into the private backyard to shower under a mango tree or savor meals in the open air. With private parking, a washer/dryer, and a prime spot just minutes from the beach and Rincón’s lively plaza, it’s the perfect haven for an unforgettable escape!Guest accessThe guests will have access to the entire home, including the garage and backyard. In the summertime, feel free to take mangoes from the mango tree in the backyard. You can also use the washer and dryer in the garage.

description: Casa Tortuga is a short block from Sandy Beach in the heart of Rincon's Puntas nightlife,. You’ll love the private 1200' roof deck, amazing ocean views, the location, art, furniture, and pool. It is great for couples, solo adventurers, families (with kids), big groups, entertaining for large events. New roof deck furniture, appliances, grill, outdoor dining room table, chaise lounges, deck refrigerator, and outside bar.The spaceSandy beach is full of energy and vacationers! Penthouse features top of the line everything, beautiful original art work, a 1200’ private finished roof deck, pool, surf boards to rent and everything is new. This is a dream rental for families (pack and play, high chair and stroller in the Penthouse), surfers, SCUBA divers, deep sea fishers, zip line/eco tourist enthusiasts, horseback riders, and golfers. The penthouse is in a 6 unit development and was completed in 2011. The main floor of the penthouse has a beautiful front balcony (rattan/wicker deck chairs and table look over the Caribbean) that opens into the great room with a brand new 50" HD TV (set up with Netflix, Roku), and a new living room set with and couch that can sleep two.. The three bedrooms sleep 7 in high quality beds (a queen in the Master, double in the second bedroom, and a double/twin bunk in the third bedroom); two bathrooms downstairs, new wwasher/dryer, all rooms have large powerful ACs (although with ocean breezes and ceiling fans you hardly ever need them) and excellent WIFI coverage; and the kitchen is fully equipped with utensils, cookware, and condiments and a brand new top Of the line stove. Much of the furniture is handmade, hand carved wood and there is original art work throughout. Including the recently painted mural on the roof deck.The private roof deck is accessed by a spiral staircase in the living room, and is 1200’ sf, with a bathroom upstairs, covered wet bar, and new gas grill, dinner table that seats 8, chaise lounges, a hammock, couch, additional seating, outlet door bar, refrigerator, and a tropical garden spread throughout. There is a docking station and reuter on the roof. Also included are beach chairs, masks, snorkels, fins, boogie boards; frisbee; and a cooler. This penthouse is perfect if you want to entertain a large group, or just kick back on the privacy of the roof deck. We are within a few minute drive to over a dozen world class surfing breaks, an amazing under water preserve that offers world class snorkeling, and walking distance to Sandy Beach and Pools Beach. Spectacular waterfalls are a 45 minute drive. No need to bring your boards if you don’t want to. For an additional fee you have access to the home’s quiver which includes; 9’0 Robert August high-end performance long board (surfteck); 9'1' McTavish Fireball (fiberglass noserider); 9’0 Rusty (gun shaped, great in the big stuff, but also a very floaty fiberglass wave catcher); and a 6’1” Firewire short board; roof racks, and wax are also included. These are all high-end personal boards and only available to my guests who prefer not to lug their boards and pay the price of flying. Other area activities include SCUBA, snorkeling, deep sea fishing, golf, sailing, water falls, para-sailing, kite-sailing, whale watching, zip-line tours, bio-luminescence bays, horse back riding, casino, tennis, shelling, hiking, jet skiing, great food, and just hanging out. The house comfortably sleeps 7 in beds, but the 7th person will incur an extra $25/night charge. We will entertain groups larger than 7 only at the owner's discretion. An extra per person fee will be applied. An additional twin/single mattress is available to use on the floor in any room.Guest accessThe penthouse is in a gated access property with swimming pool, gazebo area with bathrooms, and an outdoor shower.Other things to noteThe property has a generator that runs everything in case of a power outage in the area, excellent WIFI, large smart TV with Netflix and Roku, and a full quiver of surf boards (for rent) and beach toys (for free). We will likely need to water the plants on the roof once during a stay.
amenities: 50 inch HDTV with Netflix, standard cable

description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceRomantic, private, and overlooking tropical gardens and the Caribbean Sea, Mangó y Playa at The Villas at The Horned Dorset is the epitome of luxury in paradise. Mangó y Playa is a one-bedroom, 2 full bath luxury villa with a private plunge pool. Also, the complex offers a full-size generator & water tank in case of an interruption in electrical or water service. The villa is steps away from a stunning infinity pool and the beach is a one-minute walk away. On this beach, you can enjoy a morning or afternoon dip, appreciate the scenery and let the waves caress your feet. If you are looking to relax, enjoy quiet surroundings, and still have all the fun and action Rincón has to offer a short drive away, then this is the place for you! IMPORTANT NOTE #1: This villa is not located at The Horned Dorset Hotel (which is closed). It is located at the Villas at Horned Dorset, directly beside the hotel. The common areas and pool of the Villas are in pristine condition. Once you get off the main road, you will encounter narrow countryside roads for approx 3-5 minutes until you get to the property.IMPORTANT NOTE #2: THIS VILLA DOES NOT HAVE WIFI OR TV. IMPORTANT NOTE #3 - PLUNGE POOL MAINTENANCE: The pool man has to access the outdoor patio every Thursday during the morning to clean the plunge pool. No exceptions. Guests do not need to be at the property for this, since they don't need access to the unit. Please reach out to us before booking if you have any questions regarding this service.LIVING AREAYou’ll love how the living area seamlessly blends with the lush tropical garden just outside. This inviting space features a four-person dining table, central air conditioning, and elegant furnishings that provide a relaxed yet sophisticated ambiance. Two beautiful wooden doors open onto a private terrace with a plunge pool, surrounded by vibrant greenery and a large mango tree. It’s the perfect setting for serene mornings or peaceful afternoons. The terrace also includes two comfortable lounge chairs—ideal for sunbathing in total privacy.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThe master suite is located on the second level of the villa, offering a serene and spacious retreat. It boasts a four-poster mahogany king-size bed, Amalfi ceramics, and hand-carved furniture, along with a separate sitting area. The grand en-suite bathroom is finished floor-to-ceiling in white Carrara marble and features an oversized freestanding white porcelain bathtub, a walk-in shower, and double vanities (His & Hers), creating a luxurious, spa-like experience.PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability. KITCHENETTEThe kitchenette is located on the 1st level of the villa. It offers a small refrigerator, toaster, microwave oven, a single burner portable stovetop, a blender, and basic pots and pans for simple cooking. GETTING AROUND & PARKINGWe strongly recommend renting a car, as there are a multitude of activities within a 15-30-minute drive that you will not want to miss out on. Also, Uber is not readily available in the area, which is why it's important to have your own means of transportation. The villa includes one (1) unassigned parking spot. LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at the secluded beach, private plunge pool, and infinity pool at The Villas at The Horned Dorset. This oceanfront property has a private area where guests can wet their feet in the ocean and soak up the sun. The apartment includes beach chairs, beach towels, and coolers.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon of surfing at Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach.Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle BoardsOther things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish spongePlease note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 2 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.
